sources.entry: Cluxo - Menu bar app that highlights your mouse cursor for screencasts, presentations, and pair programming.

summary.one_liner: Cluxo is a macOS menu bar app that highlights the mouse cursor with rings, click and scroll effects, a magnifier, spotlight, keystroke display and on-screen drawing for screencasts, presentations and pair programming.
summary.what_it_does: Cluxo runs as a menu bar-only macOS app (no Dock icon) that draws a colored ring around the mouse cursor, with selectable shapes, sizes, glow and breathing animation. It adds click ripples, drag stretching, scroll direction arrows, and a cursor trail. A live magnifier (1.5x to 4x), a spotlight that dims everything except the area around the cursor, and a keystroke overlay at the bottom of the screen are also included. A draw mode (Ctrl+Option+D) provides seven annotation tools such as pen, arrow, rectangle and highlighter, and a radial menu (Ctrl+Option+comma) lets you adjust effects while presenting. Most features are controlled by global Ctrl+Option shortcuts, and settings cover colors, shapes, sizes and UI language (system, Korean, English).
use_cases: highlight the cursor during screen recordings
point at things during a live presentation
show the cursor clearly in pair programming sessions
annotate the screen while presenting or recording a demo
display keyboard shortcuts pressed on screen for tutorials
zoom into a part of the screen with a magnifier
find a lost mouse pointer with a shake gesture
how_to_run: Or download Cluxo.zip from Releases, move Cluxo.app to /Applications, and open it (right-click > Open on first launch)
Grant Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions in System Settings (Screen Recording optional for magnifier)
Development: brew install xcodegen && gh repo clone kykim79/Cluxo && cd Cluxo && xcodegen && open Cluxo.xcodeproj
CLI build: xcodebuild -project Cluxo.xcodeproj -scheme Cluxo -configuration Release build
notable: Screenshot mode toggle lets external tools like screencapture or OBS capture the overlay, while the magnifier normally excludes its own overlay from capture
Radial menu with two-level sub-values and the ability to open it via a left-mouse long press or trackpad long press
Draw mode with seven annotation tools that follow the current ring color
Trackpad gesture visual feedback (experimental) built on a private MultitouchSupport API and off by default
Event-driven cursor tracking with no polling timer; overlays per display
caveats: Requires macOS 13.0 or later; the current build is Apple Silicon only (Intel needs a Universal build)
Requires Accessibility and Input Monitoring permissions; the app is not notarized in the README, so the Gatekeeper workaround may be needed for manual install
Trackpad gesture feedback relies on a private API and is disabled by default
